WR Rankings for Week 3 of 2026 Fantasy Football Season

By Jon Mosales Published September 24, 2026 1 min read

By Jon Mosales

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Last Updated on September 24, 2026 2:41 pm by Jon Mosales | Published: September 24, 2026

The most overlooked position is often WR in fantasy football.  Teams often have three capable ones and you can always grab one on the wire.  In 3WR leagues, you really need depth at the position, especially if you’re not heavy.  On some pass-heavy teams, there are WR2s you would start over WR1s on bad passing offenses.  Situation is everything.

NFL Player News & Fantasy Analysis

  • Courtland SuttonWR, Denver Broncos

    Courtland Sutton caught three of seven targets for 46 yards.

    These are modest numbers to be the team leader in all categories at his position, but it's where we are with the 2026 Denver Broncos. Jaylen Waddle disappeared for the second time in three games, only catching tow of his seven targets for a measly ten yards. Nine players saw at least one targets, with eight of those players recording a reception. As much as fantasy managers hoped the passing game would work through Waddle and Sutton, it looks like they are going to spread it out. That's going to make it tough to trust Sutton moving forward. As for Waddle, you're likely needing to continue to start him and hope the talent comes through like it did in week two.

    6hr
  • J.K. DobbinsRB, Denver Broncos

    JK Dobbins took 17 carries for just 49 yards while being kept out of the end zone.

    Dobbins had 85% of the running back carries, with Jaylden Waddle (1) and Bo Nix (4 and a touchdown) being hte non-running backs with carries. Second year pro RJ Harvey was utilized primarily as a receiver, where Dobbins hasn't been a threat during his time in the NFL. It's hard to gauge his value moving forward, though his role in the offense appears to be safe. He should be viewed as a touchdown dependent low end flex play for managers in leagues of 12+ teams. In any sort of PPR league, Harvey may be the more productive fantasy asset as he finished with seven targets, good for a three way tie for the most in tonight's game.

    6hr
  • Bo NixQB, Denver Broncos

    Bo Nix completed 17/34 for 186 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception.

    It was a tough start for Nix and the Denver offense as a whole, who didn't get things going until the second half. He's yet to have a top 12 finish through three weeks after having seven in 2025. There may be some growing pains with new playcaller OC Davis Webb. In one QB leagues, Nix can safely be dropped until we see some signs of life from the passing game.

    6hr
  • Tyler HigbeeTE, Los Angeles Rams

    Tyler Higbee caught eight of eleven targets for 62 yards and a score.

    With Terrance Ferguson (ankle) getting banged up, it was Higbee who led a deep tight end group. It shouldn't be terribly surprising, as he's had a few years to develop chemistry with Matthew Stafford. The Rams found themselves throwing the ball more than they probably would have liked, with two players hitting double digit targets and Stafford throwing the ball over 50 times. Though volatile, it looks like Higbee may be a deep league streaming option if Ferguson were to miss extended time. Puka Nacua (groin) returning to action (whenever that may be) would most certainly take away targets.

    6hr
  • Konata MumpfieldWR, Los Angeles Rams

    Konata Mumpfield set career highs across the board, corralling four of eight targets for 93 yards and his first NFL touchdown.

    Mumpfield broke away from the Denver secondary in the fourth quarter for a 48 yard touchdown, which highlighted a career day for the second year pro. As long as Nacua is out, Mumpfield has a chance to build off of this performance, which came against what many consider a stellar secondary and defense as a whole. He should be considered as a deep league add in the event Nacua continues to miss time.

    6hr
  • Kyren WilliamsRB, Los Angeles Rams

    Kyren Williams took 15 carries for 88 yards while adding another 70 yards on six receptions.

    Williams remains the clear lead back over backfield mate Blake Corum, who averaged just 2.5 yards per carry on seven attempts with just 15 yards to show. Despite this, Corum is going to limit the upside of Williams. For those of you in PPR leagues, Corum saw four targets, though he only caught two and had zero receiving yards. You have t wonder what Williams could do if he was the bell cow. Alas, Williams remains locked in as a borderline low end RB1, high end RB2 with weekly upside in a high octane offense.

    6hr
  • Jaxon Smith-NjigbaWR, Seattle Seahawks

    Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 10 of his 14 targets for 128 yards and two touchdowns in Seattle's Week 3 loss to the Commanders.

    JSN might just be unguardable. He dominated again. He is a weekly top-five option for fantasy WRs.

    14hr
  • Sam DarnoldQB, Seattle Seahawks

    Seattle QB Sam Darnold threw 31-of-45 for 379 yards, four touchdowns, and two interceptions in the Seahawks Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders.

    The Seahawks running game was non-existent in this contest. Darnold was forced to throw it a bunch and his fantasy mangers will thank the Seahawks for that. Yes he threw two interceptions, but this is a great fantasy performance for Darnold despite the loss.

    14hr
  • Terry McLaurinWR, Washington Commanders

    Washington Commanders WR Terry McLaurin caught six of his nine targets for 77 yards and a touchdown in the Week 3 win over the Seahawks.

    McLaurin turned in a great performance to help the Commanders upset the Seahawks. He led the team in receiving yards, targets, and receptions. This type of performance should give managers some confidence to start McLaurin in their flex spots with Mariota as the starter.

    14hr
  • Marcus MariotaQB, Washington Commanders

    Washington QB Marcus Mariota throws 19-of-31 for 184 yards, three touchdowns, and no interceptions with 13 yards rushing in the Commanders Week 3 win over the Seahawks.

    This was one of the biggest surprise wins of the week. The yardage volume was not there for Mariota, but his three touchdowns are plenty to make this a solid performance. Look for Mariota to add more in the rushing game in his next few games in relief for the Commanders starter.

    14hr
